summary: Introduction to the ansible-core 2.17 porting guide describing changes from ansible-core 2.16, to be read with the 2.17 changelog.
questions: Where do I start when upgrading to ansible-core 2.17?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.16 → 2.17 overview
answer_card.answer_md: The ansible-core **2.17** porting guide lists behaviour changes since **2.16** that may require updates to playbooks, plugins and other content. Read it together with the ansible-core 2.17 changelog.
